name: Mirror Lake
summary: Mirror Lake is an introductory investigative quest for novice Alliance mages studying in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind. Tasked by Jennea Cannon, apprentices venture just southwest of the city gates to sample the waterfall waters of Mirror Lake for residual magical contamination.

sections.title: Ley Lines and Shifting Currents
sections.body: Azeroth has suffered catastrophic mystic conflicts over the recent decades, from the opening of the Dark Portal to the Third War and the battle at Mount Hyjal. These violent shocks tore ancient arcane currents from their once-stable channels. In the Wizard's Sanctum of Stormwind, magi like Jennea Cannon monitor these shifts closely, fearing that dislodged flows of arcane power might bleed into the surrounding wilderness and corrupt local ecosystems.

sections.title: Testing the Waters
sections.body: Mirror Lake lies nestled beneath the cliffs just southwest of the Stormwind gates, serving as a primary natural reservoir fed by mountain falls. Because the surrounding countryside depends on these waters, Jennea sends novice mages equipped with a glass flask directly to the base of the waterfall. Collecting fresh spray allows the Sanctum to conduct delicate scrying and reagent tests to confirm whether wild magic has begun seeping into the public water supply.

faq.q: Why does Jennea Cannon want a water sample from Mirror Lake?
faq.answer: Massive mystical wars across Azeroth have ruptured natural ley currents. Jennea Cannon fears that unsettled arcane energies are bleeding into the water table around Stormwind, which could adversely affect anyone who drinks from the lake.

Mirror Lake is situated in northwestern Elwynn Forest, tucked against the high bluffs just southwest of the main gates of Stormwind. The required sample is taken from the pool at the foot of its cascading waterfall.

faq.q: What happens if the water is tainted?
faq.answer: Jennea fears that drinking magically tainted water for too long could harm those who rely on the lake. The precise effects are not yet known.
This assignment is reserved specifically for novice mages training in the Alliance, serving as one of their earliest practical fieldwork tasks on behalf of the Wizard's Sanctum.

faq.q: Does this quest lead to further investigations?
faq.answer: It concludes the direct initial task begun with Jennea Cannon's summons, rewarding the apprentice with their first formal mage implement and establishing their duty to monitor magical disturbances across the realm.

faq.q: What caused the magical currents to destabilize in the first place?
faq.answer: Jennea attributes the changed currents to the world's massive mystic struggles, without identifying a specific battle or event.

angles.text: This task marks an apprentice's transition from reading dusty tomes in the Wizard's Sanctum to investigating real-world arcane phenomena, rewarding their first dedicated mage staff or off-hand orb.
Mirror Lake feeds the surrounding farmlands and waterways of Elwynn, making its purity vital to the daily health of Stormwind's citizenry.
Ensuring the safety of Elwynn's natural resources is one of the quiet ways the magi of the Wizard's Sanctum safeguard the heart of the kingdom.
